message:
Derive capture self-check fixtures from the capture source

FAN-3974: the two positive applicability probes compared the capture
source with the live ru.json and patch notes. After a recapture on the
current tree there is no difference, so they failed by construction.
Build the allowed edits (one leading notes entry, one description-only
ru correction) from the source text instead. Serialize the ru probes
without key sorting so the key-order check no longer rejects every probe
for the wrong reason; the empty-description mutation is now caught.
Allowlists and thresholds are unchanged.
